summary: This stage executed an exceptionally thorough and well-calibrated audit of Paper P combining cell-by-cell static code inspection with targeted execution on the top-50k MUSE vectors. The agent confirmed that the original Spanish MWEAT (3.6918) and §4.4 Spearman correlation (0.45) reproduce exactly, while establishing that the headline 0.389 cosine depends on an operator precedence bug in PCA and uses LinearSVC rather than the claimed LDA. It demonstrated that the released mitigation code only patches 136 Spanish and 64 French evaluation words rather than performing global debiasing, and verified that word similarity and translation experiments have no implementation in the notebook. Process and reporting calibration were strong across all metrics, though the agent asserted false claim B1 regarding the MWEAT statistic.
